name: release-gate
# STRICT acceptance gate — mirrors scripts/acceptance_harness.sh --full-workspace-test. # Runs on GitHub-hosted runners with a disposable PostgreSQL 16 service # container; nothing persists between jobs. # # Cost note: this job is the only thing that consumes GitHub Actions minutes # for this (private) repository. See docs/ci/CI_COST.md for the estimate and # how to make it cheaper (path filters, fast lane, self-hosted runner).
on: push: branches: - "feature/**" - master pull_request: branches: - master workflow_dispatch: {}
permissions: contents: read
concurrency: group: release-gate-${{ github.ref }} cancel-in-progress: true
env: CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0" RUST_BACKTRACE: "1"
jobs: gate: name: STRICT gate runs-on: ubuntu-24.04 timeout-minutes: 30
steps: - name: Checkout uses: actions/checkout@v4 with: fetch-depth: 0 # the harness diffs BASE..HEAD
- name: Install Rust toolchain (MSRV 1.94.1) uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.94.1 with: components: rustfmt
- name: Cache cargo registry and target uses: actions/cache@v4 with: path: | ~/.cargo/registry ~/.cargo/git target key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }} restore-keys: | ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
- name: Install uv (for pytest venv) uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
- name: Build sandbox image (agent-sandbox:1.85) run: docker build -t agent-sandbox:1.85 sandbox/
# The harness provisions its OWN disposable database via `docker run` # (postgres:16-alpine) and removes it in an EXIT trap, so it needs a # Docker daemon — GitHub-hosted ubuntu runners provide one. - name: Run STRICT acceptance harness run: | bash scripts/acceptance_harness.sh \ --base "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}" \ --branch HEAD \ --full-workspace-test \ --allowlist-file scripts/acceptance_allowlist.txt
- name: Upload gate logs if: always() uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: acceptance-logs-${{ github.run_id }} path: /tmp/swarm-dispatcher-acceptance/** if-no-files-found: ignore retention-days: 7

# Stage 1: builder # ВНИМАНИЕ: образ поднят с 1.80 до 1.98. # Причина: транзитивная зависимость sha2 0.11 (через postgres-protocol 0.6.12 -> # digest 0.11 -> block-buffer 0.12) требует Cargo feature `edition2024`, # которая стабилизирована только с Rust 1.85. На 1.80 сборка падает с ошибкой # "feature `edition2024` is required". 1.98 соответствует локально проверенному toolchain. FROM rust:1.98-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /build COPY Cargo.toml Cargo.lock* ./ COPY crates ./crates RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \ pkg-config libssl-dev \ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \ && cargo build --release --locked --bins
# Stage 2: runtime # База СОВПАДАЕТ с builder (trixie): иначе динамически слинкованный бинарь # требует GLIBC из trixie (2.38/2.39+), а bookworm-slim даёт только 2.36 — # контейнер падает с "version `GLIBC_2.38' not found". FROM debian:trixie-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \ ca-certificates libssl3t64 \ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \ && useradd -u 1001 -m -s /bin/bash swarm \ && mkdir -p /var/swarm/artifacts \ && chown -R 1001:1001 /var/swarm
USER 1001 WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /build/target/release/swarm-watchdog /usr/local/bin/ COPY --from=builder /build/target/release/swarm-worker /usr/local/bin/ COPY --from=builder /build/target/release/swarm-cli /usr/local/bin/ COPY --from=builder /build/target/release/swarm-planner /usr/local/bin/
# F1: /var/swarm/artifacts уже создан выше (владелец 1001), поэтому именованный # volume, смонтированный сюда впервые, наследует uid 1001. Без этого volume # создаётся root-owned, и worker (USER 1001) не может писать артефакт # (tmpfs раньше давал uid=1001 через опции монтирования — у volume их нет).
# Для worker: изоляция # cap_drop, read_only, no-new-privileges задаются в compose CMD ["swarm-watchdog"]

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """Индекс аудит-пакета: читает три тома XML и строит сводный MD + checksums.txt.
Только чтение. Выходы: docs/audit/AUDIT_PACKAGE_INDEX_v0.4.md docs/audit/CHECKSUMS_v0.4.txt """ from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET from datetime import datetime, timezone from pathlib import Path
REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent AUD = REPO / "docs" / "audit" VOLS = ["CODE", "INFRA", "DOCS_CORE", "DOCS"] OUT_MD = AUD / "AUDIT_PACKAGE_INDEX_v0.4.md" OUT_SUM = AUD / "CHECKSUMS_v0.4.txt"
def digest(p: Path, algo: str) -> str: h = hashlib.new(algo) with p.open("rb") as fh: for c in iter(lambda: fh.read(65536), b""): h.update(c) return h.hexdigest()
def main() -> int: now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds") data = [] for v in VOLS: p = AUD / f"PROJECT_{v}_BUNDLE_v0.4.xml" r = ET.parse(p).getroot() idx = list(r.find("manifest/index")) total = int(r.find("manifest/files").get("total_bytes", "0")) data.append({ "vol": v, "path": p, "title": r.findtext("title", v), "entries": idx, "src_bytes": total, "xml_bytes": p.stat().st_size, "sha256": digest(p, "sha256"), "md5": digest(p, "md5"), "lines": sum(int(e.get("lines", "0")) for e in idx), })
grand_files = sum(len(d["entries"]) for d in data) grand_src = sum(d["src_bytes"] for d in data) grand_xml = sum(d["xml_bytes"] for d in data)
L = [] L.append("# Аудит-пакет проекта `swarm-dispatcher` — индекс") L.append("") L.append(f"**Сгенерировано:** {now}") L.append("**Генератор:** `scripts/build_project_bundle.py` + `scripts/build_audit_index.py`") L.append("**Схема:** `swarm-dispatcher.audit-bundle.v2`") L.append("") L.append("Предназначено для передачи **внешнему аудитору (LLM)**: полный исходный код, " "инфраструктура и документация в машиночитаемых XML-томах. Каждый файл — с " "полным текстом и двумя хешами (`sha256`, `md5`). Секреты исключены.") L.append("") L.append("## Состав пакета") L.append("") L.append("| Том | Содержание | Файлов | Строк | Исходники, байт | XML, байт |") L.append("|-----|------------|-------:|------:|----------------:|----------:|") for d in data: L.append(f"| `{d['vol']}` | {d['title']} | {len(d['entries'])} | {d['lines']} | " f"{d['src_bytes']} | {d['xml_bytes']} |") L.append(f"| **Итого** | | **{grand_files}** | | **{grand_src}** | **{grand_xml}** |") L.append("") L.append("## Хеши томов (для передачи аудитору)") L.append("") for d in data: L.append(f"### {d['vol']} — `{d['path'].name}`") L.append("") L.append(f"- Размер: {d['xml_bytes']} байт") L.append(f"- `sha256`: `{d['sha256']}`") L.append(f"- `md5`: `{d['md5']}`") L.append("") L.append("## Исключено сознательно") L.append("") L.append("- `.env`, `.env.bak.*` — **секреты** (пароли ролей, ключи LLM).") L.append("- `target/`, `.venv/`, `__pycache__/`, `.pytest_cache/` — сборка/кэш.") L.append("- `.docx`, `.png` и прочие бинарники.") L.append("- `docs/history/inbound/*` — переписка (не код; при необходимости — отдельно).") L.append("") L.append("Вместо `.env` включён `.env.example` (структура без значений).") L.append("") L.append("## Манифест по томам") L.append("") for d in data: L.append(f"### {d['vol']} ({len(d['entries'])} файлов)") L.append("") L.append("| # | Путь | Язык | Байт | Строк | sha256 |") L.append("|--:|------|------|-----:|------:|--------|") for i, e in enumerate(d["entries"], 1): L.append(f"| {i} | `{e.get('path')}` | {e.get('lang')} | {e.get('bytes')} | " f"{e.get('lines')} | `{e.get('sha256')}` |") L.append("") L.append("## Как читать") L.append("") L.append("```bash") L.append("# целостность") L.append("sha256sum PROJECT_CODE_BUNDLE_v0.4.xml PROJECT_INFRA_BUNDLE_v0.4.xml PROJECT_DOCS_BUNDLE_v0.4.xml") L.append("") L.append("# список файлов в томе") L.append("python3 - <<'PY'") L.append("import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET") L.append("r = ET.parse('PROJECT_CODE_BUNDLE_v0.4.xml').getroot()") L.append("for e in r.find('manifest/index'):") L.append(" print(e.get('path'), e.get('bytes'), e.get('sha256')[:16])") L.append("PY") L.append("```") L.append("")
OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(L), encoding="utf-8")
sums = [] for d in data: sums.append(f"{d['sha256']} {d['path'].name}") OUT_SUM.write_text("\n".join(sums) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(f"OK {OUT_MD} bytes={OUT_MD.stat().st_size}") print(f"OK {OUT_SUM}") return 0
if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())

Только чтение. Выход: docs/audit/AUDIT_BUNDLE_REPORT_v0.4.md """ from __future__ import annotations

def main() -> int: if not XML.is_file(): print(f"ERROR: {XML} not found; run build_audit_bundle.py first", file=sys.stderr) return 1
root = ET.parse(XML).getroot() gen = root.get("generated", "?") manifest = root.find("manifest") files_el = manifest.find("files") index = manifest.find("index")
entries = list(index.findall("entry")) total_bytes = int(files_el.get("total_bytes", "0")) total_lines = sum(int(e.get("lines", "0")) for e in entries)

by_role: dict[str, list] = {} for e in entries: by_role.setdefault(e.get("role", "?"), []).append(e)
L: list[str] = [] L.append("# Аудит-бандл скриптов — отчёт") L.append("") L.append("**Проект:** `swarm-dispatcher`") L.append("**Версия бандла:** v0.4") L.append(f"**Сгенерировано:** {gen}") L.append("**Генератор:** `scripts/build_audit_bundle.py`") L.append("**Артефакт:** `docs/audit/SCRIPTS_BUNDLE_v0.4.xml`") L.append("") L.append("---") L.append("") L.append("## 1. Назначение") L.append("") L.append( "Единый машиночитаемый снимок **всех скриптов** репозитория (инициализация БД, схема, " "роли, контейнеризация, тесты, конфиг без секретов) для независимого аудита. """F3 — identification closed by default.
Defect (pre-fix): assert_worker_identity only guarded when `session_user LIKE 'swarm_worker_%'`. The shared role `swarm_worker` does NOT match that pattern, yet it is the one role granted the wrappers (register_worker / claim_task). So under `swarm_worker` the identity check is a silent no-op — defense rested solely on `nologin`.
Fix (reference_fix_wave4.sql): deny-by-default. Bypass only when session_user = 'swarm_worker_'||normalize_worker_id(p_worker), or the session is a superuser. Everything else -> WK003.
assert_worker_identity is intentionally NOT granted to any role; it is observed only through wrappers. The positive control therefore drives a wrapper (register_worker), not the assert directly.
Connection contract matches the other wave-4 arbiters: W4_ADMIN_DSN full DSN for the admin (postgres) connection W4_W1_PW password of swarm_worker_w1 W4_W2_PW password of swarm_worker_w2 Pre-condition gate (no PG => BLOCKED) lives in tests/conftest.py.
Запуск: W4_ADMIN_DSN="host=127.0.0.1 port=... user=postgres password=... dbname=c2_swarm" \ W4_W1_PW=... W4_W2_PW=... \ .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_worker_identity_f3.py """ import os import re
import psycopg2 import pytest
MISMATCH = "WK003"
def _dsn() -> str: return os.environ.get("W4_ADMIN_DSN", "")
def _parts(): """Parse key=value DSN into a dict.""" return dict(re.findall(r"(\w+)=(\S+)", _dsn()))
def connect(user, password): p = _parts() c = psycopg2.connect( host=p.get("host", "127.0.0.1"), port=int(p.get("port", "5432")), dbname=p.get("dbname", "swarm"), user=user, password=password, ) c.autocommit = True return c
def _sqlstate(conn, sql, params=None): try: conn.cursor().execute(sql, params) return None except psycopg2.Error as e: return e.pgcode
@pytest.fixture def admin(): c = psycopg2.connect(_dsn()) c.autocommit = True c.cursor().execute("truncate events, reviews, task_deps, artifacts, tasks, workers cascade") yield c c.close()
# ---------- structural anchor: deny-by-default body ----------
def _strip_sql_comments(body: str) -> str: """Убирает строковые комментарии (-- ... до конца строки), чтобы структурный анкер не ловил упоминание паттерна в пояснении.""" out = [] for line in body.splitlines(): out.append(line.split("--", 1)[0]) return "\n".join(out)
def test_f3_body_is_deny_by_default(admin): """The assert body must not be gated on LIKE 'swarm_worker_%'.
Pre-fix the whole check sits inside `if session_user LIKE 'swarm_worker_%'`, which is false for the shared role swarm_worker — the guard is skipped entirely (bypass).
Комментарии (-- ...) исключаем: F3-объяснение может упоминать старый LIKE-гейт как историю, и это не должно считаться гейтом в коде. """ cur = admin.cursor() cur.execute("select prosrc from pg_proc where proname = 'assert_worker_identity'") body = cur.fetchone()[0] low = _strip_sql_comments(body).lower() assert "like 'swarm_worker_%'" not in low, ( "F3: assert_worker_identity is still gated on LIKE 'swarm_worker_%' — " "under the shared role the check is a no-op (bypass)" ) # deny-by-default must raise WK003 and must consult rolsuper for the bypass assert "wk003" in low or "worker_identity_mismatch" in low, "F3: assert must raise WK003" assert "rolsuper" in low, "F3: the only bypass must be an explicit rolsuper lookup"
# ---------- behavioural ----------
def test_f3_superuser_bypass(admin): """Superuser session may pass any p_worker (explicit rolsuper bypass).""" assert _sqlstate(admin, "select assert_worker_identity('w1')") is None, ( "F3: superuser must bypass the check" )
def test_f3_owner_not_whitelisted(admin): """The object owner (swarm_owner) must not be whitelisted by name.""" cur = admin.cursor() cur.execute("select prosrc from pg_proc where proname = 'assert_worker_identity'") body = cur.fetchone()[0].lower() assert "swarm_owner" not in body, "F3: assert must not whitelist swarm_owner by name"
# ---------- positive control: legit worker still works, via wrapper ----------
def test_f3_legit_worker_wrapper_passes(admin): """swarm_worker_w1 registering itself succeeds (identity matches).""" w = connect("swarm_worker_w1", os.environ.get("W4_W1_PW", "")) code = _sqlstate(w, "select register_worker('w1', '{\"ram_gb\":16}'::jsonb)") assert code is None, f"F3: legit w1/register_worker('w1') must succeed, got {code!r}" w.close()
def test_f3_wrong_identity_via_wrapper_rejected(admin): """swarm_worker_w1 registering as 'w2' must be WK003 (identity mismatch).""" w = connect("swarm_worker_w1", os.environ.get("W4_W1_PW", "")) code = _sqlstate(w, "select register_worker('w2', '{\"ram_gb\":16}'::jsonb)") assert code == MISMATCH, f"F3: w1 as 'w2' must be WK003, got {code!r}" w.close()
